description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for handling BlueBubbles chat targets and identifiers, including parsing, normalization, and validation of chat IDs, GUIDs, handles, and related operations within the BlueBubbles messaging context.

methods.name: parseRawChatGuid
methods.description: Parses a raw chat GUID string into a standardized format if valid.

methods.name: stripPrefix
methods.description: Removes a specified prefix from a string and trims the result.

methods.name: stripBlueBubblesPrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'bluebubbles:' prefix from a string if present.

methods.name: looksLikeRawChatIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a string resembles a raw chat identifier (UUID, hex, or chat<digits> pattern).

methods.name: parseGroupTarget
methods.description: Parses a group target string into chat ID or GUID.

methods.name: parseRawChatIdentifierTarget
methods.description: Parses a raw chat identifier string into a structured target.

methods.name: normalizeBlueBubblesHandle
methods.description: Normalizes a handle string, removing prefixes and formatting.

methods.name: extractHandleFromChatGuid
methods.description: Extracts a handle from a chat GUID if it's a direct message format.

methods.name: normalizeBlueBubblesMessagingTarget
methods.description: Normalizes a raw messaging target string into a simplified form.

methods.name: looksLikeBlueBubblesTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string looks like a valid BlueBubbles target ID.

methods.name: looksLikeBlueBubblesExplicitTargetId
methods.description: Checks if a string explicitly looks like a BlueBubbles target ID.

methods.name: inferBlueBubblesTargetChatType
methods.description: Infers whether a target is a direct or group chat based on its format.

methods.name: parseBlueBubblesTarget
methods.description: Parses a string into a BlueBubblesTarget object.

methods.name: parseBlueBubblesAllowTarget
methods.description: Parses a string into a BlueBubblesAllowTarget object.

methods.name: isAllowedBlueBubblesSender
methods.description: Determines if a sender is allowed based on the allow list and chat info.

methods.name: formatBlueBubblesChatTarget
methods.description: Formats chat target info into a string identifier.
